title: Named mates and the conditions behind them
outcomes: Finds smothered mate, Arabian mate and the queen-and-bishop mate on h7
States the conditions each mate needs
Tells a mate from a check when one condition is missing

steps.text:
Some mates have names because they recur. Each name is a short list of conditions: where the king stands, what blocks its squares, and which piece protects the checker.
Learn the conditions, not only the picture. If one condition is missing, it is just a check.

steps.caption: White to move. The black king is shut in by its own rook and pawns.

line.say: The knight gives check and nothing can capture it. This is smothered mate.

claims.statement: It is White's move and the game is going on.

steps.text:
Every named mate answers the same questions about the checking move.
**Can the king move?** Count its free neighbours.
**Can the checker be captured?** By which piece?
**Can the check be blocked?** (A knight check cannot.)
A missing condition turns the mate into a check.
